head: e759163

smoke.notes: Covers q32 arithmetic vs reference (i128>>32 wrap mul, truncating div, exact isqrt), tick 7-ops + ledger, transactional breach halt with ledger bit-unchanged, 50-event rewind seed bit-equals origin with per-event exact inverses, R1-R5 sealed verdicts, receipt chain verifies from re-read file (10 links), float64 rewind-contrast DRIFT-NONZERO with finite drift numbers, egg closed shell + nursery growth, field render determinism.

essence: v -> L -> G -> v' in exact integer arithmetic: seven ops, exact rewind, no search.

ideas.name: One line at every scale
ideas.statement: Velocity produces ledger, ledger constrains gate, gate produces velocity — the same seven ops (measure, commit, consume, check, cross, force, integrate) at reflex, decision, plan, philosophy scale.

ideas.name: Conservation with transactional honesty
ideas.statement: commit/consume are STAGED and written only if gamma'+eta' <= C; a breach halts with no write, no event, no clock advance — the only reading that keeps every tick reversible. Measurements write nothing.

ideas.name: Exact inversion by construction
ideas.statement: Every event stores the full post-state {t,p,v,gamma,eta}; the pre-state is four undos recomputing the SAME pure substrate products, so add/sub cancel exactly — one deterministic fold, zero search, zero fitting.

ideas.name: Shapes that grow and close
ideas.statement: Tokens glue along shared boundary ids, a closed shape (empty boundary) becomes an egg, the nursery loop grows the interior, and break emits a Mode whose deltas render into a topology field.

ideas.name: Substrate decides exactness
ideas.statement: The loop is generic over arithmetic substrate A; Q32 BigInt is exact, float64 exists ONLY as the R2 contrast arm proving drift is a property of the substrate, not the code path.

parts.name: Q32 fixed-point integer substrate
parts.essence: BigInt i64.32 fixed point: truncating mul/div ((i128>>32) wrap), exact integer floor isqrt, ONE/HALF/LOG2_3 matching seed-arch verbatim — the hot path has no floats.
parts.gate: mul must match the (i128>>32, wrap) reference; isqrt must be the exact floor
parts.failure_mode: Any rounding would destroy the bit-equal rewind guarantee

parts.name: Substrate injection seam
parts.essence: The loop is generic over substrate A ({add,sub,mul,div,sqrt,le,isZero,...}); Q32A is the hot path, F64A exists only so the R2 contrast runs the IDENTICAL code path and op order.
outputs: same loop semantics on either substrate
parts.gate: R2 contrast must be SUBSTRATE-ONLY: identical code path, identical op order
parts.failure_mode: A divergent code path would make the float contrast vacuous

parts.name: The seven-op tick
parts.essence: Per tick: measure curvature kappa (pure), stage commit |v|^2*dt and consume H(p)*dt, conservation check, gate crossing test, force v -= grad*dt, integrate p += v'*dt, record Evt={t,p,v,g,e}. Nothing else.
outputs: new state + journal event + optional decision
parts.failure_mode: An eighth hidden op would break the seed's claim and the inverse algebra

parts.name: Transactional conservation halt
parts.essence: commit/consume are staged and written only if the check passes; on breach: no write, no event, no clock advance — the ledger is bit-identical to pre-tick, so every tick stays reversible.
outputs: commit or halted:true with untouched ledger
parts.gate: On breach the ledger must be bit-unchanged (mini-R1 sealed check)
parts.failure_mode: A plain abort after write would leave a dirty, irreversible ledger

parts.name: Measurements write nothing
parts.essence: kappa (op 1) and the crossing decision d (op 5) are pure reads — they therefore need no inverse in rewind, keeping the inversion algebra to exactly four undos.
parts.failure_mode: A measurement that wrote state would need its own inverse and break the count

parts.name: Gates as signed-distance functionals
parts.essence: Gate = {f:Vec->R, theta}: 'well' (harmonic, grad=(px,py)) and 'wall' (half-space, grad=(n)); crossing = sign flip of eval between p and p+v*dt; rising = grad.v > 0 strictly; zero joins the positive side (receipted).
parts.gate: A decision requires BOTH sign flip AND rising slope
parts.failure_mode: Sign flip without rising would admit falling exits as decisions

parts.name: Exact rewind: four undos, zero search
parts.essence: rewind(j) inverts each event from its recorded post-state: p0 = p - v*dt, v0 = v + grad(p0)*dt, g0 = g - |v0|^2*dt, e0 = e - H(p0)*dt; each recomputed product is bit-identical to its forward twin, so compose or restart folds are exact in Q32.
parts.gate: rewind(50 events) must bit-equal the origin seed (integer equality, no tolerance)
parts.failure_mode: Approximate inversion (least-squares, search) is forbidden by the charter

parts.name: Token gluing grammar
parts.essence: Tok = {r: invariant id, d: boundary ids, k: kappa}; glue(t1,t2) unions boundaries iff they intersect; shell(S) = ids appearing in exactly one token boundary (odd-degree cancellation); close(S) iff shell is empty.
parts.gate: glueAll returns null on any disjoint pair — the shape must stay connected
parts.failure_mode: Gluing disconnected tokens would fake a closed shape

parts.name: Egg lifecycle
parts.essence: egg(S) requires close(S); the nursery N starts as the interior and GROWS by adding each nursery-tick decision's 2^-4 lattice id; break fires when |N| > theta, emitting the live Mode {p,v,kappa,gamma,eta} and marking the shell open.
parts.gate: The shell boundary must stay empty up to the break (R3 asserts exactly this)
parts.failure_mode: Breaking an unclosed egg would emit from a non-interior

parts.name: Field render: deltas to topology
parts.essence: emit(m) returns the Mode's five fields verbatim; render quantizes deltas to 2^-4 lattice cells, glues same-cell deltas into nodes, links nodes at Chebyshev distance <= R=2, takes union-find components; canonically sorted, topoHash = sha256.
parts.gate: render is pure: same journal -> same topology, hash-checked (R4)
parts.failure_mode: Hidden state in render would break replay determinism

parts.name: Journal as lineage
parts.essence: Evt = exactly {t, p, v, gamma, eta}; record appends; fork(j,t) = prefix slice = new lineage; the journal is the gapless state trajectory (contiguous t asserted).
outputs: lineage that can branch at any t
parts.gate: Event t values must be contiguous 0..n-1 — a gap means an unrecorded write
parts.failure_mode: Extra fields or gaps would break the four-undo inversion contract

parts.name: Canonical bytes and hashes
parts.essence: jline serializes events with Q32 as exact decimal integers and f64 via shortest-round-trip JSON; jhash = sha256 over newline-joined lines; topology likewise canonically hashed — R4/R5 replay checks compare bytes.
parts.gate: Same state must always produce the same bytes (deterministic serialization)
parts.failure_mode: Locale or float-format drift would produce different hashes for identical state

parts.name: Charter law: decision rules before the run
parts.essence: The seed charter (first commit, never edited) demands paired arms on identical worlds, verdict rules receipted BEFORE the run, counterfactual measurement with the mechanism zeroed, loud honest negatives, and green smoke on every commit.
outputs: experiment discipline for every lane here
parts.gate: No post-hoc verdicts — the rule must precede the numbers in the receipt chain
parts.failure_mode: Post-hoc verdicts would make every sealed result unfalsifiable

parts.name: Float64 contrast arm
parts.essence: The R2 experiment runs the identical loop on f64 and receipts DRIFT-NONZERO: compose-mode seed deviation 7.48e-17, max 1.04e-16 — proving exactness is a property of the Q32 substrate, not a lucky code path.
outputs: finite drift numbers in the sealed summary
parts.gate: The contrast must show NONZERO float drift while Q32 stays bit-equal
parts.failure_mode: If float were also exact, the substrate claim would collapse

cells.expr: substrate selector: Q32A (hot path) | F64A (contrast arm only)
kappa; staged commit/consume; check; cross; force; integrate; record
breach => halted:true, ledger bit-unchanged, clock frozen
fold invert(j[n])..invert(j[0]) — four undos per event, no search
odd-degree boundary ids; close(S) iff empty
lattice glue + Chebyshev adjacency + union-find + topoHash
sha256 over canonical jline bytes — tamper evidence

layer_logic.0: Substrate is the arithmetic itself: Q32 BigInt fixed point with an injected seam so the identical loop can also run on f64 — the choice of substrate IS the exactness guarantee.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms are seven ops per tick plus three lifecycle transforms: token gluing, egg growth/break, delta rendering — each one pure, deterministic, and reversible.
layer_logic.2: Policy is thin and hard: the staged conservation check (halt transactionally), the crossing-and-rising admission for decisions, and the charter's no-post-hoc-verdicts law.
layer_logic.3: Interface is the journal: exactly five fields per event, append-only, fork by prefix — the lineage is the only thing the outside world ever touches.
layer_logic.4: Evidence is byte-level: canonical serialization, sha256 of journals and topologies, sealed R1-R5 verdicts, and the float64 contrast arm that proves exactness is substrate-borne.
